What's your return and refund policy?
• Just now
Seen • Just now
Our return policy varies by product type. Here's a breakdown:
Mattresses:
Most mattresses (Green, Vegan, Extra Firm, Wool, Organic Luxury, Latex) have a 1-year sleep trial with a 30-day minimum adjustment period and a $99 return fee.
Eco Organic Mattress has a 100-day trial with a 30-day minimum and $99 return fee.
Grand Luxe Mattress has a 1-year trial with a 30-day minimum and 10% return fee.
We require at least 30 days of use before requesting a return because most people need 60 to 90 days to fully adjust to a new mattress.
Other Products:
Adult pillows, protectors, sheets, duvets, and toppers: 100-day trial
Crib mattresses: 30-100 days depending on model
Loungewear, towels, bath products: 30-day return with fees
Wood bed frames and select furniture: 30-day return with 20% restocking fee
Important Notes:
Shipping fees, In-Home Delivery & Setup fees, and Alaska/Hawaii surcharges are non-refundable.
Refunds are processed within 1-3 business days after we confirm receipt of your returned items, though your bank may take up to two weeks to process it.
Final sale items (adjustable bases, clearance, discontinued products) are not eligible for returns.

What payment methods do you accept for an order?
• Just now
Seen • Just now
We accept several payment methods:
Standard Payment:
Credit card or debit card — payment is taken in full at the time of placing your order
Financing Options:
Affirm Financing — offers rates as low as 0% APR for qualifying customers, with terms ranging from 3 months to 36 months on purchases up to $17,500. There are no hidden fees or deferred interest.
Shop Pay Installments — for purchases between $50 and $3,000, you can split the cost into four equal, biweekly, interest-free payments. For purchases between $3,000 and $17,500, you can pay in installments over 12 months with interest. This option is powered by Affirm.
Progressive Leasing — a lease-purchase agreement (not credit) designed for shoppers with limited or no credit history. Progressive buys the mattress and leases it to you, and you take ownership after completing your payments.
Sika Health — allows you to pay using HSA or FSA funds
All financing options appear at checkout on eligible orders. Please note that Affirm financing is not currently available to Canadian customers.
